comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) rides its OWN collection - box 1 interest 3,000, box 2a/2b dividends 2,000/1,000, box 6 ordinary business income 5,000 (income 58,250, taxable 42,500); the 1,000 qualified slice takes the 0% rate (taxable below the 48,350 breakpoint), so tax 4,745 = table(41,525 midpoint on the ordinary 41,500), not table(42,525) = 4,865; overpaid 1,255.
